name: documents-media-review-taxonomy
objective: فصل media الميداني عن legal documents وفصل upload عن verification وتوحيد taxonomy/review/audit عبر app-field وPartners Control Panel.
truthOwner: Media owns binary evidence; DSH onboarding owns document requirement/review state; reviewer authority is server-side.

tasks.objective: Converge evidence and document state on explicit authoritative lifecycles.
tasks.currentProblem: Upload can be confused with verification and legal documents can share generic media semantics/taxonomy, weakening review/audit.
tasks.requiredChange: Split entities/view models as needed, normalize document types, add reviewer state/audit, and update every field/Partners tab that renders evidence.
tasks.targetState: Field can capture/upload only; reviewer verifies/rejects with reason; legal docs and visit photos have distinct metadata/lifecycle; no UI labels an upload verified before backend decision.
tasks.action: Trace media/document writers/readers, centralize taxonomy and state machine, migrate existing compatible records forward, update field and Partner Detail/Review Queue/Store tabs, then add negative/security tests.
mustNotChange: لا السماح للهاتف بتعيين reviewer status.
لا تخزين نوع معروف تحت other بعد وجود taxonomy canonical.
acceptanceCriteria: كل نوع وثيقة مطلوب قابل للسياسة والتقرير.
كل صفحات/تبويبات Partners المرتبطة تعرض authoritative status نفسه.
صور الزيارة والمستندات القانونية لا تختلط دلاليًا.
tasks.rollback: Preserve media/document history and forward-fix schema/state; never collapse verified state back into upload state.
tasks.commitBoundary: Document/media taxonomy and review lifecycle coherent batch.
